thread.title: Tim Cook says Apple Music has 50M subscribers, confirms video content plans - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brandy Betz
title: Tim Cook says Apple Music has 50M subscribers, confirms video content plans - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) CEO Tim Cook confirms that Apple Music has over 50M subscribers.
Apple disclosed 40M subscribers in April. The Subscribers number includes paid memberships and trials.
Competition: Spotify hit 75M premium subscribers recently, but has also been around for about a decade longer.
Cook’s comment came during a Bloomberg interview (clips available now, airing in June) where he also acknowledged the company’s plans to build a video content business.
Apple shares are down 0.9% to $186.54.
